input.change_text: \*\*\`Shift+Enter\`\*\* now inserts a newline instead of submitting, making it easier to write multi-line prompts.

output.subject: `Shift+Enter` now inserts newline instead of submitting in cursor CLI
output.action_text: Retrain muscle memory: in `cursor` CLI, `Shift+Enter` now inserts a newline; press plain `Enter` to submit. Scripts or muscle memory that relied on `Shift+Enter` to submit will silently start composing multi-line prompts instead.
